title: Motor Control Processes Moderate Visual Working Memory Gating Dataset
description: Raw (unpreprocessed) EEG recordings and behavioral data from 32 participants performing a visuomotor delayed match-to-sample task with interference. The study examined how motor control processes moderate visual working memory gating. Conditions crossed motor versus visuomotor interference with same versus different hand responses, alongside baseline trials with no interference.
methods_description: Participants performed a delayed color-reproduction task in a 2x2 within-subject design (same-hand or different-hand, motor or visuomotor interference) plus 240 baseline trials, across 10 blocks of 120 trials. A colored square or diamond target was shown for 500 ms, followed by a 2900 ms delay, and then participants reported the target color on a color wheel using a left or right knob. In two-thirds of trials, a left- or right-pointing triangle appeared at 900 ms during the delay and required a knob press. The triangles were gray in the motor condition and colored in the visuomotor condition. EEG was recorded throughout, and behavioral data are stored in EEG.behaviordata.
